title: calendula suffruticosa var. tomentosa
intro: Calendula suffruticosa var. tomentosa, commonly known as woolly marigold, is a variety of the calendula plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, which make it beneficial for wound healing, skin issues, and immune system support. The health benefits of woolly marigold include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting tissue repair, while its therapeutic actions include analgesic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of woolly marigold include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
